fair_value_reason: Horizon NTM non-GAAP EPS ~$3.6 (2027E ~$3.08 at a 4-6% tax rate, ~$44M interest and ~146M diluted shares, grown ~17% rather than 20% given ASPEED catch-up and lead-time cycle risk) x 38x = ~$137. Cross-check: EV/NTM sales of 12-13x on ~$1.52B, less ~$0.5B net debt, over 146M = $122-131. P/E weighted ~0.75. Down $3 from my round-1 $140; the agents' mean is $135.6.

thesis_triggers.event: ~$88 is ~29x a ~$3.05 2027E EPS and ~20% below the Aug-Sep 2026 lows ($104-111). Getting there most likely needs a 2023-24-style channel correction (distributors are 95% of revenue; in 2023 the stock fell from $97 to $56 in two months as revenue rolled over ~27% in two quarters), an AI-server capex digestion, or AMI customer attrition. Ordinary volatility would not usually take it there. Watch for ASPEED monthly sales turning negative y/y, an Avnet/Arrow book-to-bill below 1, and FPGA lead times collapsing.

supervisor_summary: Round 2 converged on LSCC fair value of ~$131-139 against a $134 close, mostly because verified factual errors were fixed, though net-debt and multiple inputs were partly copied from my round-1 file, so I count ~2-3 independent views. My checks confirmed ASPEED's +118% August (part supply catch-up), Avnet's lean 71 inventory days, the FY2024 -30.9% destock and BofA's live Sell. They also showed that the FPGA lead-time and post-rally base-rate evidence is weaker for the bull case than presented. I set fair value at ~$137 and trim the mid-to-upper ladder ~0.5 point (P(>=134) 0.498), with low confidence because the multiple is unresolved. With ~55-60% vol and a fat distributor-destock left tail, LSCC is unlikely to beat SPY on a Sharpe basis; a small, staged position at most.
key_drivers: Earnings base: 2027E EPS ~$3.05-3.12 by guidance arithmetic vs $3.21 consensus; at $134 the stock is ~43-44x 2027E and ~37x a ~$3.6 horizon NTM EPS
Channel: distributors are 95% of revenue; the FY2024 precedent is -30.9% revenue, -27% in two quarters; Avnet is lean (71 days) but on a +48% sales base

Cycle timing: allocation and long lead times (AMD/Xilinx 40-52+ weeks; Lattice prioritizing AI lines) support 2H26-1H27, but set up a double-order unwind that the market would price ahead of mid-2027 to 2028
AI-server read-through: ASPEED +118% y/y in August with supply catch-up and order visibility into 2028; strong but flattered by a supply-capped base
Supply and events: ~1.19M AMI shares tradable Oct 26 and quarterly thereafter, THL block rights, Q3 ~Nov 3
